title: Reject oversized encode when remux fallback fails
summary: Changes SizeGuardMode fallback_remux so an oversized encode is not published when the remux fallback attempt is unavailable or blocked.
reason: The operator expects Try remux fallback to publish a remux when possible and otherwise reject the oversized encode for review. The current backend attempts remux, but if remux is blocked it continues publishing the oversized encode with warning evidence.
behavior_before: When fallback_remux detected an oversized override-forced encode, the backend attempted remux fallback. If remux failed, the backend restored the encode route and published the oversized encode with warning/review evidence.
behavior_after: When fallback_remux detects an oversized override-forced encode and remux fallback fails, the backend records an operator-required encode size policy failure and returns before moving or publishing the oversized temp encode.
manual_validation: python unittest targeted fallback-remux/settings suite - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the fallback_remux publish rejection branch, restore the previous contract/help wording, refresh summaries, then rerun focused PowerShell route-selection and Python verification/settings tests. Because this is media-policy behavior, rerun representative real-media encode/remux validation after rollback if the changed behavior was exercised.
high_risk_notes: Touches post-encode size policy and publish acceptance. Validation must include focused unit/contract tests and should be followed by representative real-media validation for an oversized encode with remux fallback success and failure.
notes:
